Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 15: the slip of [[Ur'Ru'r (V) (Errata 2)|Ur'Ru'r (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR'R'R, may ▼ a weapon with "Tusken" in lore here; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, Ur'Ru'r may make a regular move.”), word for word the text of [[Ur'Ru'r (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
